Simulate a new dataset using forward sampling.

Source: R/inverse_forward_sampling.R
forward_sampling.Rd

Simulate a new dataset using forward sampling.

Usage

forward_sampling(fit, i, n, ...)

# S3 method for class 'list'
forward_sampling(fit, i, n, ...)

Arguments

fit

An object of class brmsfit or a list of brmsfit objects.

i

The index of a single posterior draw to simulate a dataset for. The index is passed to rstantools::posterior_predict()'s "draw_ids" argument.

n

Number of observations to simulate.

...

Potential additional arguments passed to brms::posterior_predict().

Value

A data.frame containing n observations for each variable in the fit.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
fit <- brms::brm(y ~ x, data = data.frame(y = rnorm(10), x = rnorm(10)))
forward_sampling(fit, i = 1, n = 100)
} # }
